name: smakometr
author: Marp
description: Web extension for private notes and ratings on pyszne.pl

scripts.lint:ext: web-ext lint --source-dir=. --ignore-files=node_modules tests playwright.config.js package*.json smakometr.zip
scripts.build:ext: web-ext build --source-dir=. --overwrite-dest --ignore-files=node_modules tests playwright.config.js package*.json smakometr.zip
scripts.run:ext: web-ext run --source-dir=. --ignore-files=node_modules tests playwright.config.js package*.json smakometr.zip
